_comment: Hand-edited concept normalization overrides (see lib/begrepp.py). `alias` maps a variant onto the canonical display form, which wins the group's name; `keep_distinct` blocks a wrong auto-merge.
_comment_punctuation: The three aliases below fold punctuation variants of one term onto the hyphen as the normalized form. `normalize_fold` folds case and whitespace only, so an en dash (U+2013) or a space where the other form has a hyphen makes a second concept -- which then renders to the SAME filename (both the dash and the space become `_` in the slug), so one silently dropped the other with an output path collision. The hyphen form is the correct Swedish typography in all three.
